title: Principal Engineer at Semtech Corporation Sees Pluggable Optics Staying Dominant as NPO Ramps and CPO Adoption Remains Limited
expert: Principal Product Definition Specialist at Semtech (current); first-hand on optical/electrical IC orders; NVIDIA's EML contracts are second-hand
verdict: A current Semtech optics engineer sees hyperscaler optical orders running in the millions and 200G EML with no free stock for 2-3 years, a bottleneck NVIDIA has locked up through Coherent and Lumentum contracts.

Rubin ramp execution: 🟢 **200G EML: no stock for the next 2-3 years**, but NVIDIA has secured supply through Coherent and Lumentum contracts (contracts second-hand); first read on EML supply. → Tenet 6 (supply execution) ↑
🟡 **CPO packaging and 3D assembly at "very limited yield"**, vs NVIDIA's plan for 15x SPIL CPO optical-engine capacity by mid-'27 (SB #63558): **conflicting**. → Tenet 4 (networking) →
Lead times / air-pocket risk: 🟢 **1.6T mass-volume deployment from 2H next year**; CW lasers tight this year, next year and the year after (first read).
Compute share vs. XPU/ASIC: 🟡 **Copper reach drops to ~1.5 m at 200G/lane (from ~3 m at 100G)**, lifting optical attach; hyperscalers still prefer multi-vendor NPO over turnkey CPO from NVIDIA or Broadcom. → Tenet 4 (networking) ↑

changes: CPO capacity: expert sees very limited CPO packaging yield vs NVIDIA's GTC Berlin target of 15x SPIL CPO optical-engine capacity by mid-'27 (SB #63558, 2026-10-21): **conflicting**.
Component supply: 200G EML sold out for 2-3 years vs the 2026-11-05 IT-services call's "supply as tight as 90 days ago": consistent (tight supply).
First read on 1.6T transceiver timing; no earlier expert call or stored row.
thesis_impact: Tenet 6 (supply executes Rubin): ↑ — NVIDIA secured 200G EML while the open market has no stock for 2-3 years.
Tenet 4 (networking/CPO TAM): → — optical attach rises as copper reach falls to ~1.5 m at 200G/lane, but CPO yield is very limited and hyperscalers resist turnkey CPO lock-in.
